attributes.visState:
{"aggs":[],"params":{"fontSize":11,"markdown":"### Account Security Across Services｜跨服務帳號安全

`jt-account-guard` · rules 132700-132799｜規則 132700-132799

串接所有 jt- 套件的登入事件：同一位址把密碼噴灑分散到多個服務、正在噴灑的位址登入成功、同一帳號從多個位址在多個服務失敗，以及某服務鎖定帳號或位址後在另一個服務登入成功。新安裝即保持安靜；需要搭配其他套件。

Joins the login events of all jt- packs: password spraying spread over several services from one address, a successful login from an address that was spraying, one account failing on several services from several addresses, and a login on one service after another service locked the account or the address out. Quiet on a fresh install; needs the other packs.

Discover query｜在 Discover 使用的查詢:

`rule.id:[132700 TO 132799] AND rule.id:/[0-9]{6}/`","openLinksInNewTab":false},"title":"jt-account-guard · About｜說明","type":"markdown"}
